          "intensity": 2,
          "tempo": "slow_burn"
        },

                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"

                "constraint_state": "free",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",

                "location_end": "Capital City - Main Gate",

                "location_end_label": "Capital City - Main Gate",
                "location_start": "Capital City - Main Gate",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_MAIN_GATE_9A5850",
                "location_start_label": "Capital City - Main Gate",
                "outcome": "Artie realizes he is basically a walking god in this religion.",
                "scene_id": 1,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 75,
                "summary": "Artie enters the city and sees the 'Temple of the D20,' where priests pray for high rolls.",

                  "golden d20 statue",
                  "praying pilgrims",
                  "white marble walls",
                  "incense smoke"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The golden spires of the capital loom over the horizon as Artie approaches the gate.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "golden d20 statue",
                  "city streets",
                  "distant archives",
                  "bustling crowds"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie leaves the praying pilgrims behind, setting his sights on the towering archives in the distance.",
                "type": "setup"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "restricted",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:1",
                "end_condition_echo": "Artie is stuck with his glass cannon build forever.",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "4:3",
                "location_end": "Capital City - Hall of Records",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_HALL_OF_RECORDS_203BDC",
                "location_end_label": "Capital City - Hall of Records",
                "location_start": "Capital City - Hall of Records",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_HALL_OF_RECORDS_203BDC",
                "location_start_label": "Capital City - Hall of Records",
                "outcome": "Artie is stuck with his glass cannon build forever.",
                "scene_id": 2,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 80,
                "summary": "Artie tries to find a 'Stat-Wiper' to fix his 1 HP, but finds out it's a crime punishable by 'Deletion'.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "towering bookshelves",
                  "deletion warning signs",
                  "ink-stained scrolls",
                  "stern librarians"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie searches the dusty archives for any mention of a stat reset.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "damp staircase",
                  "flickering green lanterns",
                  "shadowy descent",
                  "echoing footsteps"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Fizz leads Artie out of the archives and down a narrow, damp staircase into the undercity.",
                "type": "reveal"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 1,
            "title": "The City of Gold and Glitches"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "Artie escapes the raid, but the potion has a side effect: he speaks in binary for an hour.",
            "intent": "Artie looks for illegal mods to help him survive.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:2",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "4:4",
                "location_end": "Capital City - Undercity Market",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_UNDERCITY_MARKET_BAD635",
                "location_end_label": "Capital City - Undercity Market",
                "location_start": "Capital City - Undercity Market",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_UNDERCITY_MARKET_BAD635",
                "location_start_label": "Capital City - Undercity Market",
                "outcome": "Artie gains access to a 'Lag-Switch' potion.",
                "scene_id": 3,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 65,
                "summary": "Fizz leads Artie to a black market run by a group of 'Dev-Haters' who sell items that bypass System rules.",

                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "flickering green lanterns",
                  "lag-switch vials",
                  "hooded merchants",
                  "binary whispers"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The air in the undercity is thick with the smell of ozone and illegal code.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "tavern door",
                  "spilled ale",
                  "dark corner",
                  "informant's hood"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie slips away from the merchant stalls and ducks into a dark corner of a nearby tavern.",
                "type": "transition"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "sheltered",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:3",
                "handoff_mode": "combat_disengage",
                "hands_off_to": "4:5",
                "location_end": "Capital City - Shady Tavern",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_SHADY_TAVERN_20D6D8",
                "location_end_label": "Capital City - Shady Tavern",
                "location_start": "Capital City - Shady Tavern",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_SHADY_TAVERN_20D6D8",
                "location_start_label": "Capital City - Shady Tavern",
                "outcome": "The rivalry with Vane just became a religious war.",
                "scene_id": 4,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 85,
                "summary": "Artie meets an informant who tells him that Vane is the son of the High Priest of RNG.",

                  "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
                ],

                  "scarred wooden table",
                  "informant's hood",
                  "rng priest sigil",
                  "spilled ale"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The informant leans in close over the scarred wooden table, his face hidden by a deep hood.",

                  "sentinel iron masks",
                  "glowing blue spears",
                  "shattered tavern door",
                  "panicked patrons"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The sound of heavy boots echoes through the tavern as the Sentinels kick the doors open.",
                "type": "reveal"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "fleeing",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:4",
                "end_condition_echo": "Artie escapes the raid, but the potion has a side effect: he speaks in binary for an hour.",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "4:6",
                "location_end": "Capital City - Undercity Alleys",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_UNDERCITY_ALLEYS_BC4F38",
                "location_end_label": "Capital City - Undercity Alleys",
                "location_start": "Capital City - Undercity Alleys",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_UNDERCITY_ALLEYS_BC4F38",
                "location_start_label": "Capital City - Undercity Alleys",
                "outcome": "Artie escapes, but the potion has a side effect: he speaks in binary for an hour.",
                "scene_id": 5,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 75,
                "summary": "The black market is raided by the 'System Sentinels,' and Artie has to use his first 'Lag-Switch' to escape.",

                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"

                  "sentinel iron masks",
                  "glowing blue spears",
                  "lag-switch stutter",
                  "binary speech bubbles"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie uncorks the lag-switch potion and bolts into the alleys as the Sentinels close in.",

                  "parchment flyer",
                  "shield of health icon",
                  "arena crowd noise",
                  "colorful banners"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "A colorful flyer slaps against Artie's face as he stumbles out of the alleys and into the sunlit plaza.",

              }
            ],
            "section_id": 2,
            "title": "The Underground Market"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "The stage is set for the final confrontation.",
            "intent": "Set up the climax of the book.",

              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:5",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "4:7",
                "location_end": "Capital City - Arena Plaza",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_ARENA_PLAZA_D37DD7",
                "location_end_label": "Capital City - Arena Plaza",
                "location_start": "Capital City - Arena Plaza",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_ARENA_PLAZA_D37DD7",
                "location_start_label": "Capital City - Arena Plaza",

                  "parchment flyer",
                  "shield of health icon",
                  "arena crowd noise",
                  "colorful banners"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie peels the flyer from his face and reads the bold text while catching his breath in the plaza.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "heavy ledger",
                  "empty coin pouch",
                  "registration quill",
                  "crit-iculous signature"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie approaches the registration desk with a shaky hand, the roar of the arena in his ears.",
                "type": "choice"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "processed",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:6",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "4:8",
                "location_end": "Capital City - Registration Booth",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_REGISTRATION_BOOTH_8A04F7",
                "location_end_label": "Capital City - Registration Booth",
                "location_start": "Capital City - Registration Booth",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_REGISTRATION_BOOTH_8A04F7",
                "location_start_label": "Capital City - Registration Booth",
                "outcome": "Artie is now broke and must win the tournament to survive.",
                "scene_id": 7,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 60,
                "summary": "Artie registers under the name 'Crit-iculous' and accidentally sets his entry fee to 'All My Gold'.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "heavy ledger",
                  "empty coin pouch",
                  "registration quill",
                  "crit-iculous signature"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The clerk slides the heavy ledger toward Artie, waiting for his signature.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "glowing duplicate scroll",
                  "golden balcony rail",
                  "cruel smile",
                  "arena sand"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "As Artie walks away penniless, the registration list is magically duplicated and sent to the VIP boxes.",
                "type": "consequence"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:7",
                "end_condition_echo": "The stage is set for the final confrontation.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "location_end": "Capital City - Arena Balcony",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_ARENA_BALCONY_DFA09A",
                "location_end_label": "Capital City - Arena Balcony",
                "location_start": "Capital City - Arena Balcony",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CAPITAL_CITY_ARENA_BALCONY_DFA09A",
                "location_start_label": "Capital City - Arena Balcony",
                "outcome": "The stage is set for the final confrontation.",
                "scene_id": 8,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 60,
                "summary": "Vane sees the name on the roster and smiles, knowing he can finally 'delete' Artie in front of a crowd.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "golden balcony rail",
                  "system override scroll",
                  "cruel smile",
                  "arena sand"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Vane's fingers trace the name 'Crit-iculous' on the parchment delivered to his high perch.",
                "type": "escalation"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "The Arena Invitation"
          }
        ],
        "stakes_shift": "The stakes move from physical survival to social navigation and avoiding the 'System Police'.",
        "title": "The Capital of Crits"
      }
    ]
  },
  "phase_report": {
    "candidate_seams": [
      {
        "from_scene_ref": "4:1",
